features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description:
At 3rd level, choose one:

**Colossus Slayer.** Once per turn, +1d8 damage on a hit if the creature is below its HP max.
**Giant Killer.** When a Large+ creature within 5 ft hits/misses you, use reaction to attack it.
**Horde Breaker.** Once per turn, when you make a weapon attack, make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 ft of the original target.

choices.name: Hunter's Prey
choices.description: Choose Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, or Horde Breaker.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description:
At 7th level, choose one:

**Escape the Horde.** Opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.
**Multiattack Defense.** When hit by a creature, +4 AC against all subsequent attacks from that creature this turn.
**Steel Will.** Advantage on saves against being frightened.

choices.name: Defensive Tactics
choices.description: Choose Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description:
At 11th level, choose one:

**Volley.** Action: ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 ft of a point in range (separate attack rolls, need ammo per target).
**Whirlwind Attack.** Action: melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 ft (separate attack rolls).

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description:
At 15th level, choose one:

**Evasion.** DEX saves for half damage: take none on success, half on fail.
**Stand Against the Tide.** When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, use reaction to force it to repeat the attack against another creature of your choice.
**Uncanny Dodge.** When an attacker you can see hits you, use reaction to halve the damage.

choices.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
choices.description: Choose Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge.
